notes: ACCESS: Tier (a) direct HTTP (curl, Chrome UA impersonation) was blocked - kavehome.com/robots.txt and all pages served a 'Vercel Security Checkpoint' JS challenge page instead of content. Escalated to Tier (b): Playwright headless Chromium (bundled binary, no stealth flags needed) loaded all pages successfully with full SSR HTML (Next.js), including robots.txt (200, plain text, sitemap links intact). robots.txt User-agent:* has no ClaudeBot/anthropic-ai mention and no blanket Disallow:/, only disallows admin/cart/api/category(query)/checkout paths - none of which were used. Tier (c) Claude-in-Chrome not needed/not used (confirmed disconnected). TREE: union of (1) header mega-menu link scrape (all <a> under <header> on homepage after hydration), (2) https://kavehome.com/category-sitemap.xml -> es/en/categories-sitemap.xml (270 category URLs) keyword-scanned for storage/textile terms to catch nodes absent from the mega-menu (found floor-cushions, bed-pillows, quilts-duvets, textiles-for-teens, textile-art, magazine-racks, storage-units, coat-racks this way), (3) each category page's own breadcrumb + PRODUCT TYPE facet, used as tie-breaker evidence for ambiguous storage/furniture nodes. QTY: 'N products' text rendered on each category listing page (or 'See results (N)' on pages using that phrasing), read from the hydrated DOM body text; h1 and canonical checked to match the requested slug on every leaf (one bad slug, /o/storage-units, silently resolved to the general Furniture hub page (h1='Furniture', 216 products) instead of a real 'storage units' category - excluded, not recorded as a leaf). EXCLUDED (Storage): the entire nav cluster reachable from /r/storage-furniture (Chests of drawers, Coat racks, Coat hangers and hooks, Console tables, Shoe racks) plus Shelves/Shelves-and-shelving-units, Bookcases and cabinets, Sideboards, TV stands, Magazine racks - all confirmed via the site's own h1='Furniture' hub page (/o/storage-units) and its PRODUCT TYPE facet (Bookcases and cabinets, Sideboards, Tv stands, Coat hangers and hooks, Shelves, Coat racks, Console tables, Shoe racks all tagged 'Furniture' by the site itself) and via the /r/storage-furniture and /r/hallway-furniture-console-tables-shoe-storage pages' own PRODUCT TYPE facets (100% 'Furniture'). Generic 'Baskets' (19 products, breadcrumb 'Decor accessories', mixed decorative/functional, no storage qualifier in name) excluded per storage.md section 5. 'Kids storage units' (breadcrumb 'Baby & Kids furniture') excluded - resolves to a single product that is itself a kids chest of drawers (furniture), for consistency with the Chests of Drawers exclusion. 'Bathroom accessories' and 'Shelves' (bathroom-organization related-links) excluded as generic accessories/furniture, not storage-specific. EXCLUDED (Textile): 'Cleaning and protection for fabrics' and 'Cleaning and protection for wood' (cleaning products, not textile items themselves). 'Pouffes and floor cushions' excluded - breadcrumb 'Baby & Kids furniture', products are pouffes/footstools (furniture), not primarily textile. 'Textile art' excluded - breadcrumb 'Kave Gallery', a fine-art gallery section; MATERIAL facet shows only 1 of ~16 pieces is Fabric (rest Paper/unspecified/mixed media unique artworks priced 899-2899 EUR), so the category as a whole is Wall Decor/art, not home textile, per textile.md section 14. INCLUDED (Textile, notable): 'Garden furniture covers' (19, breadcrumb 'Cleaning and maintenance') included standalone per textile.md section 12 (explicit outdoor furniture-cover textile item); its sibling cleaning-product nodes were excluded so no 'Cleaning and maintenance' grouping row was emitted (would have been an orphaned parent). 'Floor cushions' (2, breadcrumb 'Soft furnishings', products are literally 'floor cushion covers') included as a direct Soft-furnishings leaf, distinct from the excluded kids-furniture 'Pouffes and floor cushions' page. 'Pillows and duvets' (r/pillows-duvets, 18) is a grouping page whose two children, Pillows (/o/bed-pillows, 9) and Quilts and duvets (/o/quilts-duvets, 9), sum exactly to 18 - recorded as a group with those two leaves rather than as its own leaf row, per the parent-category-URL rule. 'Laundry baskets' (6, breadcrumb 'Decor accessories') included in Storage despite the Decor-accessories nav placement because storage.md sections 5 and 11 explicitly name Laundry Baskets as a Storage-qualifying item with an unambiguous functional (not purely decorative) purpose - flagged for review given the breadcrumb conflict. 'Cushion fillers' (10, breadcrumb 'Soft furnishings') included at MEDIUM confidence - not explicitly named in textile.md but is a cushion-line insert product sold under the Soft Furnishings taxonomy, analogous to the explicitly-listed Mattress Toppers/Protectors.
